page.layout: One printed page: decorative woodcut ornament at top; dedication title and address centred; then running text in one column; a catchword-like signature "* 2" and catchword "justitiæ" at the foot right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Magnifico Nobilissimoque Viro,
CASPARO VOSBERGIO,
main_text.p: Equiti, Domino de Yfelaer, &c. in Illuftri Ordinum Generalium vnitarum Prouinciarum confeffu Delegato Ordinario,

EX quo has Orationes nostras, quæ in omni fere argumenti genere versantur, tuo nomini inscripsimus, neque tu de virtute tua, cujus testimonium pro dignitate è tot jam dignitatibus præclare gestis amplum confecutus es, neque nos de affectu quicquam immutauimus, nisi quod ex illo major semper admiratio accessit. In supremo olim Senatu, inter tot illustres viros, qui aut in hoc ordine eluxerunt quondam aut cum dignitate maxima nunc locum obtinent, justitiæ

page.notes: The initial E is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as "EX". The page number is printed as a star-marked signature "* 2" at the foot left of the catchword. Some letters in the scan are worn; "fere" and "tuo" read clearly, no illegible passages.
